She is a kind, warm-hearted woman who has held my hand through many awful things, such as my lack of sleep and skyrocketing anxiety and depression. I want to tell her that my trust in her has been dissolved and that my home life has become difficult due to the personal information she revealed about me. Obviously this would not help me at this point since I just graduated, but it would be cathartic. WIBTA?
